title: Kiritani Haruka — This Place I've Returned To〔Part2〕Side Story (Part 2)

meta.Event: At The End of The Unraveled Thread

rows.Line: Stage SEKAI

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Hello!

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line:
Welcome, girls♪
Are you here to practice?

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line:
Oh...
Hehe. You're all smiling. That must mean you've got some good news for us.

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line:
Oh, wait...!
Does this mean your episode of iHaz aired?!

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: That's right! Good call, KAITO!

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: We heard that your shoot went well, but it finally aired?

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line:
How was it?
I hope they didn't edit it in a funny way.

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: We appreciate your concern, MEIKO.

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line:
But there's no need to worry...
Actually, maybe I shouldn't say it. I think we'd rather have you see for yourselves.

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Yeah, you should've seen Shizuku! She was so amazing!

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: She was?! Hehe. I can't wait to see.

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: Then, we'll need to set up a place where we can watch it.

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: I've made it so we can play videos on the stage's big display! Here, use this cord!

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: KAITO, when did you...?

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: Hehe. Excellent work♪

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line:
Thank you very much, KAITO.
I'll play it now.

rows.Speaker: Marina
rows.Line:
<So, let's bring in our guests!
Give a big round of applause for MORE MORE JUMP!>

rows.Speaker: Arisa
rows.Line: <Aren't your fans from when you were still in Cheerful * Days going to be disappointed?>

rows.Speaker: Arisa
rows.Line: <More to the point, Shizuku, tell us. Which one is the real you?>

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line:
<However, I chose to just be myself.
Which...>

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: <Which made me realize how there are some things that only the real me had to offer. And I found that some were willing to accept me for who I really am...>

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: <So, even if I end up disappointing some of my old fans, I'm going to keep doing my best to spread hope to as many people as I can... As myself.>

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line:
Th-That was awesome...!
I was so moved!

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line:
Yes, me too.
I started tearing up a little while listening to your story, Shizuku.

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: Me three. I'm sure your fans felt glad that they kept supporting you all this time after hearing what you said.

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Yeah, you should've seen the response she got!

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: I know, right?! We got so many messages saying, “I saw iHaz!” and “You're the best, Shizuku! What you did was so cool!” We still haven't gotten a chance to read all of them yet.

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: Hehe. I'm so glad for you, Shizuku.

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Thank you all very much.

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line:
A job well done, Haruka.
And you too, Airi. You both did a wonderful job of supporting her.

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Hehe. Thank you, MEIKO.

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: I really need to thank you again...

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: It was because of you I was able to make that decision to appear on TV, MEIKO.

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: As your fan, I want to say, “Don't worry.”

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: Including the hope and warmth you wish to spread to others.

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: And those things mean quite a lot to me...

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: So, a TV appearance isn't going to easily change how I feel about all of you.

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: Why you decided to become an idol in the first place or how you felt back then...

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: So, now might not be a bad time to look back on all that.

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: It was because of your words, we all got to take this big step forward.

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: So...

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Thank you very much, MEIKO.

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: Hehe. You're very welcome♪
